title: Run model: a fixed run after a failed one reads the data again
summary: Runs the same local -> relata job twice under one job name: first with an invalid token (fails, nothing lands), then with the token fixed. The fixed run must read the same files and records again and deliver all of them; Relata must gain exactly that many chunks.

steps.title: Copy 2 lab pages with a run marker
steps.explain: Unique content so Relata stores every chunk.

steps.title: Count Relata chunks (Before)
steps.explain: Relata DocumentChunk row count before the run.

args.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM DocumentChunk

steps.title: Submit with an invalid token
steps.explain: POST /api/v1/jobs with the TOML base64-encoded, exactly as the console does.

steps.title: Wait for the failing run
steps.explain: Polls the task result and GET /api/v1/runs until this run reaches a terminal status.

steps.title: First run is not COMPLETED
steps.explain: The token is wrong, nothing can land.

steps.title: Submit again with the token fixed
steps.explain: POST /api/v1/jobs with the TOML base64-encoded, exactly as the console does.

steps.title: Wait for the fixed run
steps.explain: Polls the task result and GET /api/v1/runs until this run reaches a terminal status.

steps.title: Fixed run COMPLETED
steps.explain: With a valid token the job must succeed.

steps.title: Fixed run read the same files again
steps.explain: A failed run must not mark its input as done.

steps.title: Fixed run read the same records as the failed one
steps.explain: All the data is read again.

steps.title: Fixed run delivered every record
steps.explain: Nothing is skipped on the retry.

steps.title: Count Relata chunks (After)
steps.explain: Relata DocumentChunk row count after the run.

args.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM DocumentChunk

steps.title: Relata gained exactly the fixed run's delivered chunks
steps.explain: The failed run stored nothing; the fixed run stored everything.
